scope: governance repair only for sub-agent unauthorized git execution loophole

problem.root_cause: P34A prohibited commit/push authority but did not require command-level forbidden git write/ref lists in every work order.

rules_added: When commit_push_authorized=false, git add, git commit, git push, git checkout, git reset, git branch, git tag, git merge, git rebase, and any git write/ref command are forbidden.
Every bounded work order must include forbidden_commands and allowed_git_commands.
Missing forbidden_commands or allowed_git_commands invalidates executor authority.
Unauthorized git artifacts become quarantine_pending_parent_validation even if already pushed.
Sub-agent final responses must not emit git directives unless exact git authority was granted and used.
State reconciliation flags must not contradict accepted_committed_pushed status.
